mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_id, release_version, product_code, merchant_id, country, currency, payment_method, channel_id, priority, weight, status FROM routing_rule ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, rule_id, release_version, product_code, merchant_id, country, currency, payment_method, channel_id, priority, weight, status FROM routing_rule WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routing_rule (rule_id, release_version, product_code, merchant_id, country, currency, payment_method, channel_id, priority, weight, status) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{releaseVersion}, #{productCode}, #{merchantId}, #{country}, #{currency}, #{paymentMethod}, #{channelId}, #{priority}, #{weight}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE routing_rule SET release_version = #{releaseVersion}, product_code = #{productCode}, merchant_id = #{merchantId}, country = #{country}, currency = #{currency}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, channel_id = #{channelId}, priority = #{priority}, weight = #{weight}, status = #{status} WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId}
